notes.text: Management said the Gulf Coast liquefaction train remains on schedule, but construction labor availability and turbine supply remain execution risks.
Analysts asked whether a regulatory investigation into pipeline right-of-way compliance could delay the interconnect expansion or create a permitting headwind.
Static project tracker shows steel, transformer, and contractor costs increased, creating margin compression risk if fixed-price EPC protections are exhausted.
New take-or-pay transmission contracts expand the rate-base pipeline and may accelerate EBITDA growth once the substations enter service.
Management highlighted a record order book and said asset-sale proceeds could reduce external equity needs, but final proceeds are still unverified.

kpis.name: Construction work in progress
kpis.observation: Higher capital deployed into regulated transmission and LNG expansion projects.

kpis.observation: Static KPI shows cost pressure and supply delay exposure on transformers and gas turbines.

kpis.name: Contracted capacity backlog
kpis.observation: Long-term contracted pipeline supports cash flow visibility and expansion opportunity.

kpis.name: Debt to capital
kpis.observation: Elevated leverage may increase refinancing risk if rates remain high.
